description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git blame' in various formats, including setup of test cases, commits, and verification of blame outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks their success conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs, reports differences.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, used for timestamping in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
